abstract: We identify a novel channel of international financial contagion driven by investor expectations. Using a unique dataset linking investors' cross-country GDP growth expectations to their equity mutual fund investments and to funds' country allocations, we show that inflows into mutual funds respond strongly to fund-level expected growth, whereas funds' country allocations react only weakly to country-specific expectations. This asymmetry generates co-ownership spillovers: negative expectations about one country propagate mechanically to other countries held in the same funds, even in the absence of changes in the country
abstract_zh: 地缘经济碎片化——即国际交易日益局限于政治立场一致的伙伴之间的现象——给单个国家带来了风险，但也为一些希望成为“连接器”国家的经济体创造了机遇。我们通过引入随国家间地缘政治距离增加而上升的冰山成本，对标准贸易模型进行了修正。研究表明，人均消费对地缘政治冲击的反应取决于两个相关但不同的指标：脆弱性，即一个国家
title: Granular Portfolios, Expectations, and International Capital Flows
title_zh: 外汇市场中的羊群效应

abstract: This paper studies how large language models (LLMs) trade off moral norms against economic incentives in discriminatory hiring decisions. Bridging discrimination economics and the literature on the moral alignment in computer science, we submit 18 frontier and local LLMs to the factorial vignette experiment of a published human survey that manipulates the motive of discrimination (customer taste-based versus statistical), the cost of non-discrimination, and explicit moral injunctions. We extend this design with LLM-relevant factors: model and user personas, reasoning instructions, scenario realism, and conversational memory. In line with the literature, we find that LLMs align with humans in the direction of the effects manipulated in the survey; we also find important inter-model heterogeneity. Beyond, we contribute to the literature with, to the best of our knowledge, five novel results: 1) the market-oriented motive (customer-taste) overwhelmingly sways models in favour of discrimination, much more than what happens for human respondents; 2) models are more polarised than humans in response to moral injunctions; 3) classic prompt engineering interventions (user stated motives and model personas) have a weak impact on the models’ “moral compass”; 4) post-training alignement, not scale, shape inter-model heterogeneity, which means that de-biasing is possible but must be explicitly implemented by model providers and 5) memory effects suggest that moral permissivity in the models can be induced by conversational contextual effects.
abstract_zh: 数据中心目前占美国电力需求的4.4%，然而，超大规模企业用于宣称碳中和的可再生能源证书（RECs）和购电协议（PPAs）在电网层面的有效性仍不明确。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中数据中心运营商在RECs、PPAs和表后共置之间进行选择，而发电商则在内生融资成本下做出进入决策。该模型识别出一个时间错配——即电力消费与可归因的可再生能源发电之间的时间差——作为核心机制，通过这一机制，即使RECs覆盖100%的年度消费，AI需求仍会降低可靠性、推高电价并增加排放。配备储能的共置模式直接解决了这一时间错配，并通过消除发电商的收入风险，促使最大规模的可再生能源进入。我们利用大语言模型的分阶段发布作为自然实验，通过双重差分法对连接AI活动与地方电网结果的新数据集进行检验，以验证这些预测。AI需求显著增加了数据中心附近化石燃料发电量、批发价格（在受影响的PJM区域高达25%）和停电频率（每年额外增加0.5至1次停电），且影响规模随模型尺寸扩大。配备现场发电的数据中心在电能质量效应上表现出符号反转，这与模型预测一致。
title: The Customer Is Always Right? How LLMs and Humans Judge Discrimination
title_zh: 学生时间的财政不承认：衡量美国公立K-12教育中的强制性学生学时

abstract: Nash equilibrium (NE) arises from selfish utility maximization, yet its social welfare can be arbitrarily far from optimal. Moreover, computing an NE is intractable in general. We study augmented game models in which players use budget-balanced internal transfers to improve incentives before play. We first introduce \emph{Self-Enforcing Transfer Equilibrium} (SETE), where players commit to nonnegative peer-to-peer transfers that are paid only if the recipient does not deviate from a prescribed strategy. For polymatrix games, we show that every stationary point of the social welfare function, in particular any socially optimal strategy profile, can be sustained as a SETE. This induces a Nash equilibrium in the agent normal form of the corresponding augmented game. We further propose a polynomial-time algorithm and a decentralized learning dynamic to compute such product-form equilibria. We then introduce \emph{Mediated Self-Enforcing Transfer Equilibrium} (M-SETE), where a mediator makes both the payment schedule and the prescribed strategies binding offers. This additional enforcement resolves the agent-normal-form limitation: an M-SETE is a Nash equilibrium of the augmented game itself, not merely of its agent normal form, and any socially optimal strategy profile can be supported as an M-SETE in any finite game while preserving budget balance. Thus, internal transfers improve welfare and computation while preserving independent play on the equilibrium path. When full sequential-game stability is required, binding mediation provides the corresponding implementation.
abstract_zh: 国际投资者如何根据生物多样性风险调整投资组合？利用投资基金的月度组合数据，我们发现2021年《昆明宣言》促使基金经理将投资组合从高生物多样性风险国家重新配置至风险较低的国家，而最终基金投资者对此并未作出反应。基金经理减少了极端高生物多样性风险的敞口，但并未将低生物多样性风险视为盈利机会，从而将生物多样性定性为下行风险因素。投资基金会引发跨国溢出效应，因为这种重新配置触发了显著的资本流动，使同一地理区域内但基金所在国以外的国家受益。
title: Equilibrium with Internal Transfers
title_zh: 主要发达国家科技领域监管创新战略分析研究

abstract: An increasing number of countries use balanced budget rules (BBRs) to control government debt, with the potential cost that BBRs constrain the governments
abstract_zh: 流动性是现代固定收益市场的核心，但往往被过于简单化地对待。债券通常被描述为具有流动性或缺乏流动性，仿佛流动性是证券本身固有的固定属性。本书挑战了这一观点，认为流动性并非债券的永久特征，而是一种由市场结构、融资安排、抵押品规则、交易商能力、估值实践、监管及投资者行为共同创造的脆弱状态。《杠杆固定收益系统中流动性风险的内生性》构建了一套清晰的理论，阐释流动性如何在金融体系内部被创造，又如何在压力下消失。一只债券在平静市场中可能看似易于出售、可通过回购融资、可被接受为抵押品且日常估值稳定，但这些特质可能依赖于某些条件——当波动性上升、融资收紧或大量投资者同时试图退出时，这些条件会迅速改变。
title: Expenditure Smoothing under Balanced Budget Rules
title_zh: 应对社会老龄化对收入不平等的影响：马来西亚案例研究

abstract: Do central slums provide essential economic and social benefits to the poor? We collected bespoke data for 5,000 households to study mass forced clearances in Addis Ababa. Evictees were offered alternative subsidized housing further from the center. Exploiting sharp clearance zone boundaries, regression-discontinuity estimates show negative impacts on social networks, but positive impacts on work, earnings, housing quality and environmental amenity. Relocating households close to their ex-ante neighbors eliminates social costs. Slums are not essential: relocation policies can be designed to fully compensate residents, and the sale value of cleared land more than covers the cost.
abstract_zh: 准确的股票价格预测一直是支撑量化交易与投资决策的关键且具有挑战性的金融科技任务。近期研究致力于建模股票市场中各类复杂关系，以实现更可靠的股价预测。这些方法高度依赖强静态先验假设，要么基于预定义结构建模单只股票的时间依赖性，要么建模不同股票间的空间依赖性，但驱动股价波动的复杂市场动态仍未被探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的博弈论建模方法，通过捕捉异质投资者互动来实现股价预测。核心思想是将博弈论机制嵌入异质图结构，精细建模目标股票相关异质投资者间的动态策略互动。此外，采用时间位置编码来反映时间窗口内不同时间步的每个博弈事件对未来股价波动的差异化影响。借助异质图网络，我们通过投资者博弈代理股票市场的复杂动态，实现所有节点间的实时信息传播与节点更新。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法有效超越了现有最先进的股价预测方法。
title: No Place Like Home? The Causal Effect of Forced Relocation from Central Addis Ababa
title_zh: 行动中的区域一体化发展

abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on the key drivers of job satisfaction. We ask individuals to describe, in their own words, what they like and dislike about their jobs. These open-ended questions allow us to capture what comes to mind most naturally. We analyze the resulting free-text responses using GPT-4 to identify and classify categories of job amenities. Our main study draws on a sample of 500 full-time U.S.-based employees aged 30 to 55. We find that flexible work arrangements, workplace relationships, and autonomy consistently rank among the most valued aspects of work, while poor workplace relationships, long work hours, and heavy workloads dominate the list of dislikes and rank above factors such as pay. Our approach offers a fresh lens on what job amenities workers are most satisfied and dissatisfied with.
abstract_zh: 波兰银行税对广义信贷市场（包括贷款利率和规模）的影响，已有研究通过标准双重差分法（DID）进行了充分论证。然而，正如Borusyak等人（2024）所指出的，在交错处理设定（如波兰银行税案例）中，若处理效应在时间维度和截面维度存在异质性，该方法可能产生有偏估计。现有研究均未采用能解决此缺陷的异质性双重差分法。本研究采用异质性双重差分法评估银行税的经济后果，并探讨其他方法论选择。研究发现：银行税降低了存款利率，提高了购房贷款利率，并改变了银行资产的构成与规模。但未发现政府债券对信贷的长期挤出效应（尽管债券规模上升，信贷规模并未下降），也未发现银行税对盈利能力的影响。采用更优方法所得结果与早期运用因果推断方法的研究结论并无显著差异。
title: In their own words: What Workers Like and Dislike about their Jobs
title_zh: 不同市场，相同待遇？全球招聘与住房歧视比较研究

abstract: This study develops a finite-network gauge-econometric framework for measuring systemic shock thresholds in global and corridor flow networks. The central problem addressed is that conventional macroeconomic indicators describe output, growth, income depth, inflation, or trade exposure, but do not by themselves identify how systemic stress circulates through corridor-sensitive network structures or when a local disturbance becomes systemically transmissible. To address this gap, the study constructs a two-layer empirical architecture. Layer A is a completed ten-node benchmark of global and corridor-sensitive regional nodes connected by twenty-seven weighted undirected edges. Public macroeconomic anchors are transformed into a normalized systemic-stress field and then into a corridor-weighted graph, a stress-weighted adjacency matrix, an anti-symmetric economic gauge potential, triangular curvature, Yang-Mills economic action, a stress Laplacian, an Economic Mass Gap Index, fragility, BridgeStress, resilience, and scenario-based shock diagnostics. Layer B specifies a 100-country by 15-year validation architecture, producing a planned N = 1,500 country-year panel for fixed-effects, two-way fixed-effects, Driscoll-Kraay, clustered, dynamic-panel, panel-IV, factor, and external-validation models once the country-year variables are populated and estimated. The corrected benchmark yields a positive finite-network economic mass gap of lambda_1 = 0.3850, with spectral radius 3.5023 and normalized transition threshold 0.1099. Positive spectral separation is retained under high-weight, medium-filtered, and sparse-filtered graph specifications, while Monte Carlo perturbations keep the mass gap positive across the reported uncertainty interval. The curvature-action layer reports total Yang-Mills economic action of 2,514.0 and a top-five action concentration of 78.329%, indicating that systemic stress-energy is concentrated in a limited set of network cycles. Scenario simulations show that inflation, financial-spread, trade/logistics, and energy/geopolitical corridor shocks weaken spectral protection, compress the local-to-systemic threshold, and increase curvature/action concentration. EMGI, fragility, and BridgeStress further distinguish large output-mass nodes from strategically exposed corridor nodes such as the Caucasus and Central Asia. The finite-network dataset and replication package are archived on Zenodo as Version v1, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20786199 (Gondauri, 2026). The study contributes a reproducible macro-corridor measurement pipeline that integrates systemic-risk theory, network topology, spectral graph diagnostics, gauge-theoretic analogy, and econometric claim discipline. The term mass gap is used strictly in the finite weighted-graph sense and does not claim a solution to the mathematical Yang-Mills existence and mass gap problem. Stronger causal and country-level econometric claims are reserved for the populated and estimated N = 1,500 panel.
abstract_zh: COVID-19疫情对国际贸易造成了重大冲击，并引发了对国际供应链负面影响的担忧。通过将一项独特的企业调查与德国行政数据相匹配，我们提供了关于企业如何应对疫情引发的供应链中断而进行调整的新证据。研究发现，因疫情而面临中间投入品获取困难的企业，其调整供应商网络的可能性显著高于未遭遇此类问题的企业，尤其是当供应链中断影响到海外进口时。遭遇供应链困难的企业更倾向于用距离更近的供应商替代距离较远的供应商。然而，这些针对疫情的调整似乎是暂时性的。
china_relevance_reason: 工作论文摘要包含中国研究常见主题词，需要 AI 确认
title: Economic Yang–Mills Mass Gap in Global and Corridor Flow Networks: A Finite-Network Gauge-Econometric Framework for Measuring Systemic Shock Thresholds
title_zh: 化肥价格上涨背景下的作物保险与氮肥减量

abstract: We exploit conditionally random assignment of case files to judges in a Southern U.S. state to study the effects of same-gender judge assignment on juvenile justice decisions and long-run socioeconomic outcomes. Using a generalized differences-in-differences design, we find evidence of same-gender gaps in sentencing decisions: relative to males, female judges are 18% less likely to incarcerate female than male defendants. A novel rank-order test confirms these findings and indicates that the results are not driven by a small subset of judges. Own-gender judicial assignment, especially for Black children, has lasting effects on socioeconomic outcomes beyond the courtroom: educational attainment increases while adult criminal involvement and welfare use decrease. Further analyses suggest that these long-run improvements are not just driven by differential incarceration decisions.
abstract_zh: 人口快速增长、需求激增、干旱、资源供应波动以及供应链中断等危机，日益暴露社会技术系统中隐藏的脆弱性。与此同时，这些危机也为制度和治理创新创造了政治动力和现实紧迫性，因为应急措施往往成为常规实践的雏形。本文为卢旺达构建了一个国家层面的多部门水-能源-排放（W-E-E）情景模型，并利用该模型检验了需求增长、水文压力以及供给侧选择如何共同影响2050年前的能源安全与排放轨迹。分析表明，在SSP2尤其是SSP5增长条件下，排放仍主要由需求驱动；因此，即使是最为雄心勃勃的需求侧和供给侧措施，也最好被理解为减缓而非完全逆转排放增长的路径。本研究的贡献在于识别出哪些效率提升、电气化、可再生能源部署、火电退役以及水文风险管理组合，能在复合危机下最有效地降低系统压力并提升韧性。
title: Judicial Gender Match in Juvenile Courts: In-Court Sanctions and Long-Run Socioeconomic Consequences
title_zh: 随机Volterra过程的泛函分部积分公式

abstract: Pension funds use interest rate swaps to hedge the interest rate risk arising from their liabilities. Analyzing regulatory data on Dutch pension funds, we show that pension funds with worse funding ratios, indicating greater fragility, use swaps more aggressively. These swap positions expose pension funds to the risk of margin calls, which can exceed 6% of their total assets, when interest rates rise. Pension funds respond to realized margin calls by selling safe government bonds with medium-term maturities. This procyclical selling behavior adversely affects the prices of the sold bonds and thereby exposes pension funds to market liquidity risk.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2013年4月至2026年1月期间（每序列3,163个观测值）的每日EMBI（新兴市场债券指数）数据，分析了17个拉丁美洲国家及两个区域总体的主权债券利差的长期记忆特性。参数方法显示，所有19个序列均呈现分数积分特征，对数转换后利差的估计阶数介于0.97（乌拉圭）至1.22（洪都拉斯）之间。其中九个序列的置信区间上限超过1，表明冲击具有持久性效应；在自相关误差假设下（如Bloomfield模型），乌拉圭是唯一利差序列呈现均值回归特征的国家（其分数参数置信区间低于1）。上述结果在误差项设定（白噪声或自相关）及允许非线性确定性趋势的条件下均保持稳健。
title: Pension Liquidity Risk
title_zh: 青年性别工资差距研究：来自埃及、约旦和巴勒斯坦的启示

abstract: Information and communication technology (ICT) goods are central to digital transformation, technological upgrading and participation in global production networks. Yet relatively little is known about whether immigrant networks shape international trade in these knowledge‐intensive goods. Using bilateral panel data for 172 countries over the 2000–2021 period, we estimate gravity‐based specifications, Tobit models and linear fixed‐effects models for ICT goods trade. The results show a positive and statistically significant relationship between immigrant networks and ICT goods trade, especially exports. The export relationship remains positive after controlling for productive capacity, while the import relationship weakens. Interaction models further show that immigrant networks are more strongly related to ICT goods trade when immigrants' home countries have greater ICT export capacity. Marginal‐effect estimates indicate that the relationship operates through both the extensive and intensive margins of trade. The findings suggest that immigrant networks are especially relevant for ICT goods trade when cross‐border social and commercial ties connect destination markets to technologically capable home countries.
abstract_zh: 信息与通信技术（ICT）产品是数字化转型、技术升级及参与全球生产网络的核心要素。然而，关于移民网络是否影响这类知识密集型产品的国际贸易，学界认知仍相对有限。本研究基于2000—2021年间172个国家的双边面板数据，采用引力模型设定、Tobit模型及线性固定效应模型对ICT产品贸易进行估计。结果显示，移民网络与ICT产品贸易（尤其是出口）之间存在显著正向统计关系。在控制生产能力后，出口关系仍保持正向，而进口关系则有所减弱。交互模型进一步表明，当移民母国具备更强的ICT出口能力时，移民网络与ICT产品贸易的关联性更为显著。边际效应估计显示，该关系通过贸易的扩展边际与集约边际共同发挥作用。研究结论表明，当跨境社会与商业联系将目的地市场与技术能力较强的母国相连接时，移民网络对ICT产品贸易具有特殊重要性。
title:
Immigrant Networks, Productive Capacity and Trade in
                    ICT
                    Goods
title_zh: 移民网络、生产能力与ICT产品贸易

abstract: This paper uses linked Census records from 1871 to 1901 to compute intergenerational mobility for Canadian regions and census divisions. The results reveal sharp differences in mobility over space: Ontario featured high relative and absolute mobility, Quebec low relative and absolute mobility and the Maritimes low absolute mobility. Local differences in human capital endowments and labour market inequality are correlated with division mobility patterns but do not account for regional differences, where migration and structural change toward industry and services appear important. Comparing spatial patterns of Canadian mobility in the 19th century to today shows substantial changes for Quebec districts.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1871年至1901年的关联人口普查记录，计算了加拿大各地区及普查分区的代际流动性。结果显示，不同地区的流动性存在显著差异：安大略省具有较高的相对流动性和绝对流动性，魁北克省则表现出较低的相对流动性和绝对流动性，而滨海省份的绝对流动性较低。地方人力资本禀赋和劳动力市场不平等与分区流动性模式相关，但无法解释区域差异，其中向工业和服务业的迁移及结构转型似乎更为重要。将19世纪加拿大流动性的空间格局与当今对比，发现魁北克地区发生了显著变化。
title: The geography of economic mobility in 19th‐century Canada
title_zh: 19世纪加拿大经济流动性的地理分布

abstract: We study the object reallocation problem with transfers. We show that if a rule satisfies endowments-swapping-proofness, strategy-proofness, individual rationality, and no subsidy (or non-imposition), then it is equivalent to the top trading cycles rule without transfers (TTC without transfers). Therefore, even when transfers among agents are permitted, no transfer occurs under the class of rules satisfying these four properties, not even in the form of fixed prices.
abstract_zh: 我们研究带转移的对象再分配问题。我们证明，若某一规则满足禀赋交换防操纵性、策略防操纵性、个体理性及无补贴（或非强制）条件，则该规则等同于无转移的顶级交易循环规则（TTC without transfers）。因此，即便允许代理人之间进行转移，在满足这四个性质的规则类别下，也不会发生任何转移，即便是以固定价格的形式也不会出现。
title: Endowments-swapping-proof object reallocation with transfers
title_zh: 带转移支付的禀赋互换防操纵物品再配置

abstract: We analyze competition in service markets with unit demand prone to adverse selection, such as secured lending and car insurance markets. Incumbent firms learn their customers’ types over time and can price discriminate accordingly. We prove existence of a unique set of mixed strategy equilibria where firms randomize prices over a bounded continuous support. Incumbents earn positive rents. Increased competition through firm entry does not benefit customers if firms know portfolio compositions of competitors. If firms only possess information regarding the aggregate industry client composition, horizontal mergers may reduce industry rents, a finding with implications for competition policy in information-intensive industries.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们分析了存在逆向选择风险的单元需求服务市场中的竞争，例如担保贷款和汽车保险市场。在位企业会随时间推移了解客户类型，并据此实施价格歧视。我们证明存在一组唯一的混合策略均衡，其中企业在有界连续支撑集上随机定价。在位企业可获得正租金。若企业了解竞争对手的投资组合构成，则通过企业进入加剧竞争并不会使客户受益。若企业仅掌握行业整体客户构成的汇总信息，横向并购可能降低行业租金，这一发现对信息密集型行业的竞争政策具有启示意义。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Competition on service markets with unit demand and learning
title_zh: 单位需求与学习效应下的服务市场竞争

abstract: We propose a novel measure of fiscal policy divergence based on public budget data. First, we quantify policy similarity across municipalities based on the cosine similarity of their budget allocations, showing strong correlations with geographic proximity and differences in socio-demographic characteristics. Next, we predict budget similarity out-of-sample using a flexible machine-learning model trained on pairwise differences in local characteristics, defining fiscal divergence as the municipality-year average absolute prediction error. In an empirical application to 8000 Italian municipalities (2000–2015), we show that electoral-cycle patterns are concentrated on the expenditure side of the budget: expenditure divergence is lower in pre-electoral years than in election years, whereas revenue divergence follows a different and less stable pattern.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文基于公共预算数据提出了一种衡量财政政策差异的新方法。首先，我们利用预算分配的余弦相似度量化各市镇间的政策相似性，发现其与地理邻近性及社会人口特征差异存在强相关性。其次，我们采用灵活的机器学习模型，基于地方特征的两两差异对预算相似性进行样本外预测，并将财政差异定义为市镇-年份层面平均绝对预测误差。在对意大利8000个市镇（2000-2015年）的实证分析中，我们发现选举周期模式集中于预算支出端：选举前年份的支出差异低于选举年份，而收入差异则呈现不同且较不稳定的模式。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Fiscal policy divergence

abstract: We study the relationship between health and social status in China using genealogical data from the 14th to 19th centuries. The data covers broad segments of the population linking husbands, wives, and sons, allowing us to examine whether status was associated with survival not only for adult men but also across households and generations. In a sample centered on the early 1700s, the typical lifespan of married men is 52, but varies widely. High-status men have a 22 percent higher probability of living past 50 than low-status men, resulting in a lifespan advantage of seven years. High status is also associated with significant survival advantages for wives and children. The lifespan premium of the wife of a high-status man over the wife of a commoner exceeds 10 years, and the chance that the son of a high-status man dies before reaching 10 years is less than half that of a low-status man’s son. Up to the 17th century the lifespan advantage is largely confined to those with top status, while the healthstatus gradient across all status levels emerges during the 18th century. The findings provide new evidence on health-status inequality in a less-studied setting, and suggest that health-status inequality is usefully analyzed from a family and intergenerational perspective.
abstract_zh: 本文利用14至19世纪中国的家谱数据，研究健康与社会地位之间的关系。数据覆盖了广泛的社会阶层，将丈夫、妻子和儿子联系起来，使我们能够考察地位是否不仅与成年男性的生存状况相关，还涉及家庭内部及代际之间的影响。在以18世纪初为中心的样本中，已婚男性的典型寿命为52岁，但个体差异显著。高地位男性活过50岁的概率比低地位男性高22%，寿命优势达七年。高地位还与妻子和子女的显著生存优势相关：高地位男性妻子的寿命比平民妻子长超过10年，而高地位男性之子在10岁前死亡的概率不到低地位男性之子的一半。直至17世纪，寿命优势主要局限于顶级地位群体，而18世纪期间，所有地位层级之间均出现了健康-地位梯度。这些发现为较少被研究的背景下的健康-地位不平等提供了新证据，并表明从家庭和代际视角分析健康-地位不平等具有重要价值。
